secondaries: the same difference per fed point 4..9, and with January refits (rolling, ML v2 monthly-rolling logistic)
close-trained stack (point 9 + ML v2 logistic) minus the consensus stack, fed points 4..9
the full cross-feed matrix (trained on 0 / consensus / 9, fed 0..9)
raw log loss of every sparkline point and of market.json's close

winner beyond the close: B3 (close + ML v2 logistic + point 1, free signs, fit 2019-2023) minus B0 (close + ML v2 logistic) -- the only beyond-close variant that passed the ml2 0.0005 rule (best of 7)
Q1: out-of-sample R^2 of the move to the close (coefficients fit <= 2023) from points 0, 1, 4, 8; CLV and ROI of betting ML v2's side at points 0, 1, 4, 8 for edge thresholds 0, 0.03, 0.05, 0.10
